capabilities: Wrap selected text in a callout with a chosen type
Change or remove the type of an existing callout under the cursor
Insert an empty callout template when nothing is selected
Define custom callout types with display labels
Configure default fold state and header titles
extras: Ships without a default hotkey to avoid conflicts; manual installation from three files until listed in the community plugin directory; not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff; English and Chinese interface.
intentEvidence: no more remembering the > prefix on every line, no more fixing blank lines around the block
problem: Typing callout syntax by hand means remembering the > prefix on every line and fixing blank lines around the block, which is slow and error-prone.
summary: Hotkey-driven tool that wraps selected text in a callout via a searchable type palette, and changes or removes types on existing callouts.
